339-677-8249-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2178-2527-3143-3899.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2178-2527-3143-3899.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

3165-3532-5078-7753.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3641-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3641-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7510.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2438-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-2750-2963-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
2388-2750-2963-6587.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

240-413-3480-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

1765-3967-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-3967-5972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1029-4474-7010.description:
Activate Gran-Gran by tapping it, adding {1}.
Gran-Gran triggers, causing you to loot.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Gran-Gran.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4369-6235.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4050-4369-6235.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Agate Instigator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Agate Instigator triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Agate Instigator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

81-4038-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to its power.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marvin due to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3062-5775-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3062-5775-7009.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
3062-5775-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Avatar Kuruk, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. At the end of combat, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Avatar Kuruk and causing Avatar Kuruk to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger and Fortune trigger.
Resolve the Fortune trigger, causing you to scry 2.
Resolve the Legend of Kuruk triggers, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1477-3661-4053-6989.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

618-5147-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2921-3234-3293-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2921-3234-3293-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat
2921-3234-3293-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2018-2111-5226.easyPrerequisites:
You control a black creature.
You do not control a blue creature.
2018-2111-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Wingrattle Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1322-2105-3204-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Godo or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1322-2105-3204-4251.description:
Declare either Godo or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Godo or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Godo or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

372-1809-3603.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1253-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Gyre Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
1253-1909-4486.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Gyre Engineer.
Repeat.

224-3585-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-3585-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

2226-2397-4415.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2226-2397-4415.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-4415.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {2}{W}.
When Stonecloaker enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stonecloaker triggers, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Stonecloaker triggers, exiling two cards from any graveyard.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{G}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use that mana to activate Zacama's other abilities.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1745-2811-3054-4647-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have gained life this turn.
1745-2811-3054-4647-4871.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Elas il-Kor's second ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast a spell from your graveyard.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3774-4499-5287.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
3774-4499-5287.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to mill four cards and create four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Dihada, causing Dihada to become a creature that is no longer a planeswalker.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dihada.
Repeat.

654-774-3861.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Orzhov Basilica.
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1870-2390.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than or equal to an opponent's life total.
1870-2390.description:
Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}.
Eternity Vessel enters the battlefield with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing damage to target opponent equal to the counters placed this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1339-2178-5028-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Arcanis the Omnipotent.
Arcanis the Omnipotent does not have summoning sickness.
1339-2178-5028-5147.description:
Activate Arcanis by tapping it, drawing three cards.
The Locust God triggers three times, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardmennt by sacrificing an Insect.
Arcanis triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1987-3075-3448-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-3075-3448-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
